about: SPEC/33 §3 geometry contract: the map features and spatial relations the study's keys, items and texts depend on. Site metres from IGN (x east, y north; ETRS-TM35FIN 519 000 E, 6 746 000 N), compass degrees. `features` and `relations` are generated by `npm run map:contract:extract` (tools/topo-map/checks/contract-extract.ts, relation list in contract-specs.ts) on the map the scenario was authored on; `curated` is hand-written and kept by the extractor. `npm run map:check` evaluates every relation on the map built now and lists the texts no entry covers.

curated.about: Hand-curated (SPEC/33 §3), kept verbatim by npm run map:contract:extract. relations: what the texts state in numbers the map must still give (stated value and tolerance, not the measured one). textRules: distances in texts that are derived at build (recomputed from the fire run, the unit placement or authored tactics), so no map relation binds the number itself; the map features they are measured from are bound by the generated relations.

relations.note: the dense spruce (Kuusimäki, truth fuel spruce_mature) begins ~500 m NE of the 13:40 map's fire, along the head's line
relations.knownViolation: SPEC/33 stage 9 (20 Oct 2026): on the rebuilt map spruce_mature patches lie inside and beside the 13:40 fire in the 25–70° wedge, so this measure reads 0 m whatever the text says; along the head's line (50° from the 13:40 head) the continuous Kuusimäki stand begins ~550 m ahead (fuel_truth.asc traced every 25 m), which the bubble now states as 'noin 500 m' (was 'noin 400 m'). The measure cannot tell a patch from the stand; a head-line measure would need a new contract measure (tools/topo-map, not this stage's)

relations.note: the radio's ~20 km detour for the heavy tankers stopped at the R3 bridge
relations.knownViolation: SPEC/33 stage 9 (20 Oct 2026): on the rebuilt map no truck route reaches R2 from the R3 bridge's east end without the bridge on the map at all (∞ over main, gravel and forest roads): the heavy tankers must leave the map along the maantie, as the radio says ('kiertotielle maantien kautta, noin 20 km'); the ~20 km lies off the map and cannot be measured here (the generated travel_time.OUT_detour, min 15 km, accepts ∞). The text is consistent with the map; the mark stays because the measure cannot give a finite value
